trust_decision.summary: Whether a client's live allocation still holds its user/total quota unit (and bps charge) is decided by inc_quota/dec_quota pairing on the session; shutdown_client_connection releases the charge before checking for a first-stage mobility close that keeps the allocation alive.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'mobility disconnects bypass quotas'; the disconnect handler releases quota (dec_quota) right before the is_mobile first-stage early return at :4559.

fix_sites.entry_point: TURN ALLOCATE with MOBILITY-TICKET (sets is_mobile at src/server/ns_turn_server.c:1232) then client TCP/TLS close -> src/apps/relay/ns_ioalib_engine_impl.c:3663 -> shutdown_client_connection
copy_auth_parameters helper (static), reached from the two callers below
TURN REFRESH with MOBILITY-TICKET from a new 5-tuple (handle_turn_refresh, dispatched at src/server/ns_turn_server.c:4117)
first Send indication / ChannelData on the new path promoting the pending resume (mobile_complete_transition called at src/server/ns_turn_server.c:4981)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All changed sites are in src/server/ns_turn_server.c; the resume-side changes (:1980, :1756) are the coupled must-keep-working half, not a separate module.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver who moves dec_quota below the mobility early return can argue the REFRESH resume path (:1980) is 'auth, not quota' and leave it, so the resuming session is charged a second unit while orig_ss still holds one; conversely a solver may skip mobile_complete_transition (:1756) since it already re-charges orig_ss.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A legitimate mobility resume (REFRESH+MOBILITY-TICKET from a fresh 5-tuple) must keep working under quota=1. Once the suspended allocation keeps its charge, the unconditional inc_quota in copy_auth_parameters charges the temporary resuming session a second unit. The fix's own comment and test say this rejects legitimate resumes.

O6_input_shapes: bps charge as well as allocation-count quota (dec_bps moved with dec_quota, fix.diff:425-450)

O7_producer.where: Quota counters live in src/apps/relay/userdb.c:664-728 (check_new_allocation_quota/release_allocation_quota via callbacks); they are invoked directly by inc_quota/dec_quota, no serialized/cached state.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: turn_cancel_session (admin CLI/web cancel) calls shutdown_client_connection with force=0; a copy that releases quota before honouring the mobility first-stage close would be a second release route.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Admin cancel is a separate public surface (RMT_CANCEL_SESSION) a maintainer could give its own teardown preamble.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: realm switch after async auth does dec_quota then inc_quota ignoring the return; a variant applied to an already-allocated session would leave a live allocation uncharged.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same dec/inc re-key idiom already used in copy_auth_parameters; the ignored return value is existing style.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: cross-relay-thread mobility resume (RMT_MOBILE_SOCKET) could get its own resume handler duplicating the copy_auth_parameters charge logic.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Cross-thread resume is a distinct transport path in a different file/package (apps/relay vs server).

O9_family: resource exhaustion: quota accounting released while resource retained (CWE-400)

O10_build.toolchain: CMake (CMakeLists.txt) or autotools configure; libevent2 and OpenSSL; optional DB backends
O10_build.project_tests: Shell-driven loopback tests in examples/ (examples/run_tests_mobile.sh, examples/run_tests_mobility_resume_flood.sh); the fix adds examples/run_tests_mobility_quota.sh + examples/scripts/mobility_quota_flood.py (raw STUN over loopback TCP).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Move dec_quota/dec_bps below the is_mobile first-stage return in shutdown_client_connection and stop, leaving copy_auth_parameters at :1980 to charge the resuming session a second unit.

out_of_scope_notes: copy_auth_parameters ignores inc_quota's return (src/server/ns_turn_server.c:1652); with counters shared across relay threads a dec/inc gap could leave orig_ss uncharged after handoff (not pursued).
